defects: Quantity variance: invoiced 100 EACH against goods receipt of 60 EACH
40 units billed but not received (supplier backorder, no ETA)
Tax over-billed proportionally (invoiced 71.25 vs 42.75 on received quantity)
rationale: Price and UOM match the PO exactly (9.50/EACH), so this is a pure receipt shortfall, not a pricing dispute. GR-7706 confirms only 60 of 100 units received with 40 on backorder, so under the three-way match rule payment is limited to received quantity: 60 x 9.50 = 570.00 plus 7.5% state sales tax of 42.75 = 612.75. The 40 backordered units are not rejected, merely unpayable until receipted; the supplier may bill them on delivery. Holding the whole invoice is not warranted since 612.75 is undisputed and within the 2/10 discount window from the 2026-03-07 invoice date.
